decisions.reason: As the flagship shown on the home page in a growing industry, the transactional email service likely meets aspirations, and a firm that is hiring has the slack to keep developing it.
The capture service has its own page and supports the firm's stated push into electronic document workflows, so its results give little reason for problemistic search.
Email-fax conversion is a low-cost extension of the core messaging infrastructure, and slack from industry growth lets the firm carry it even with modest results.
This feature sits close to the established fax business and costs little to maintain, though it is only mentioned and could be folded into the core service.
Sandbox threat protection matches strong demand for email security among regulated customers and strengthens the firm's security positioning, so results likely meet aspirations.
Multi-engine virus scanning is a near-core security add-on with low marginal cost that fits the firm's compliance-focused offer.
